description: Upsert up to 50 entries in one SQLite transaction. One explicit_user_intent covers the batch. Rejects secret-shaped keys/values. Namespace-aware.

entries.description: Upsert up to 50 entries atomically in one transaction.

key.description: Stable identifier for the memory entry. Free-form text. Treat as case-sensitive.

metadata.description: Optional small JSON object with provenance/notes. Subject to same secret-detection rules.

tags.description: Optional list of tags for grouping/filter/bulk-delete.

explicit_user_intent.description: Must be true. Set ONLY when the current user message explicitly asks the agent to modify memory (set/forget/export). Do not infer intent.

name: memory_set_batch
